reddit.title: Introducing Detailed Materials Management in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share a significant update to our building system in Provincia! Instead of a vague cost badge, each build tile now displays a detailed materials list. This allows you to see exactly what resources are stored and what is required for construction, with any shortages clearly highlighted. This change is designed to enhance your building experience and ensure you have all the necessary materials at hand. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

steam.title: Enhanced Materials Management in Provincia
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce a major update to how you manage building materials in Provincia! Each paid build tile now features a dedicated materials control, providing a clear overview of what resources you have and what you need. No more hidden costs or confusion—plan your constructions with confidence! Learn more about this update here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
